title: Toast Skagen with prawns and dill
steps: Cook the prawns in simmering salted water for 2–3 minutes, cool in cold water and chop roughly.
Stir the yoghurt with mustard, very finely chopped onion, dill, lemon juice and salt and fold in the prawns.
Toast the bread in a little butter on both sides until golden.
Put a lettuce leaf on the bread, top with the prawn mixture and serve with dill and a lemon wedge.
